# plot_electrostatic_volume { #mofography.visualize.plot_electrostatic_volume }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Plotly Volume trace for electrostatic grids with configurable isosurface levels.

```python
visualize.plot_electrostatic_volume(potential_V, cell, atoms)
```

Create a Volume trace for the electrostatic potential with meaningful isosurfaces.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                           | Default    |
|-------------|--------|---------------------------------------|------------|
| potential_V |        | 3D array of potential values in volts | _required_ |
| cell        |        | Cell matrix                           | _required_ |
| atoms       |        | ASE Atoms object                      | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description   |
|--------|--------|---------------|
|        |        | Volume trace  |
